name: clawd-ballet
description: Clawd in a pink tutu, dancing ballet on a little stage above the prompt while Claude works

order.title: Ballet: order
order.description: The order the ballets play in. "in turn" follows the programme; "shuffled" picks the next ballet at random, its acts still in order.

speech.title: Ballet: speech bubbles
speech.description: Whether the dancers say anything (a title, a story beat, a joke). Off, every piece is danced in silence.

label.title: Ballet: live label
label.description: In live mode, the chip at the top left naming what set off each move (grep, read live.ts, git log). Off, Clawd just dances.
